note: the light's y sign is flipped, so a bevel lit from 90 degrees lights the top edge instead of the bottom, caught by BevelTests.lightFromBelowAtNinety
the bevel ignores up, so a sunk edge is lit like a raised one, caught by BevelTests.downSwapsTheLight
the bevel height is not clamped at size, so the top keeps sloping past it and lights the middle, caught by BevelTests.flatPastSize
